cal_iou_oriented_boxes: calculate IoU between two sets of oriented 2D bounding boxes with shape (B, N, 5)
cal_diou_oriented_boxes: calculate distance IoU loss for oriented 2D bounding boxes using smallest enclosing box
cal_giou_oriented_boxes: calculate generalized IoU loss for oriented 2D bounding boxes with configurable enclosing type
cal_iou_3d_rotated_boxes: calculate 3D IoU for rotated bounding boxes that are only rotated around the Z axis
cal_giou_3d_rotated_boxes: calculate 3D generalized IoU loss for rotated bounding boxes around the Z axis
